# Ceiling and challengers

<!-- GENERATED by src/12_ceiling_and_challengers.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Question: how much of the shipped model's test AUC do simple group-mean lookup tables reproduce, and do per-mode or time-aware LightGBM challengers beat them? Target is the proxy `Late_delivery_risk` (not RTO). All AUCs are on the TEST split with 95% percentile bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples of test rows).

## Setup

| Split | Orders | Date range | Positive rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Train | 46,026 | 2015-01-01 -> 2017-03-16 | 54.85% |
| Validation | 9,863 | 2017-03-16 -> 2017-09-05 | 54.50% |
| Test | 9,863 | 2017-09-05 -> 2018-01-31 | 55.05% |

Chronological 70/15/15 split produced by `chrono_split_orders` from `src/02_train.py`. `same_day_pm = (Shipping_Mode == 'Same Day') & (order_hour >= 12)`. Lookup tables are plain group means (no smoothing); a group unseen in the fit data falls back to the global mean.

## Part A - Group-mean lookup tables (fit on train+val)

| Grouping | Groups | ROC-AUC [95% CI] | Unseen test rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) Shipping_Mode | 4 | 0.7291 [0.7206, 0.7374] | 0.00% |
| (b) Shipping_Mode + same_day_pm | 5 | 0.7579 [0.7503, 0.7659] | 0.00% |
| (c) Shipping_Mode + same_day_pm + Type | 20 | 0.7707 [0.7616, 0.7795] | 0.00% |
| (d) (c) + order_hour | 384 | 0.7712 [0.7617, 0.7800] | 0.00% |

## Part B - Per-Shipping_Mode LightGBM with random-hash control

Repo features (`CATEGORICAL_FEATURES` + `NUMERIC_FEATURES`) plus control `cust_hash7 = Customer_Id % 7`, preprocessor and trees fit on that mode's train rows only, early stopping (50 rounds, AUC) on that mode's validation rows. A useful model should rank the control near the bottom; a high gain share means the trees are fitting noise.

| Mode | n train / val / test | Test prevalence | Trees | ROC-AUC [95% CI] | Control gain share | Control rank |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same Day | 2,478 / 554 / 539 | 50.3% | 1 | 0.9936 [0.9897, 0.9966] | 0.00% | 201 of 201 |
| First Class | 7,049 / 1,517 / 1,513 | 95.0% | 4 | 0.8831 [0.8628, 0.9012] | 0.00% | 225 of 225 |
| Second Class | 8,929 / 1,926 / 1,923 | 76.9% | 1 | 0.5525 [0.5255, 0.5839] | 1.62% | 9 of 226 |
| Standard Class | 27,570 / 5,866 / 5,888 | 38.1% | 10 | 0.5251 [0.5097, 0.5405] | 2.66% | 10 of 241 |

## Part C - 3-column lookup vs shipped model (same test rows)

Lookup = Shipping_Mode + same_day_pm + Type. Shipped model = `models/final_model.joblib` raw scores (preprocessor from `models/preprocessor.joblib`). Paired bootstrap resamples the same test rows for both scorers; diff = AUC(lookup) - AUC(shipped).

| Scorer | Fit data | Test ROC-AUC [95% CI] |
|---|---|---|
| Shipped LightGBM | train | 0.7716 [0.7625, 0.7804] |
| 3-column lookup | train+val | 0.7707 [0.7616, 0.7795] |
| 3-column lookup | train only | 0.7707 [0.7616, 0.7795] |

| Comparison | AUC difference [95% CI] | CI vs 0 | Share of resamples lookup better |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lookup (train+val) - shipped | -0.0009 [-0.0052, +0.0033] | includes 0 | 33.3% |
| Lookup (train only) - shipped | -0.0009 [-0.0052, +0.0033] | includes 0 | 33.3% |

The train+val lookup sees 15% more (and more recent) data than the shipped model, so the train-only row is the like-for-like comparison.

## Part D - 4-fold expanding-window time check

Train+val+test rows pooled and sorted by `order_date`, cut into 5 equal blocks. Fold k trains on blocks 1..k and tests on block k+1. Lookup = Shipping_Mode + same_day_pm + Type fit on the whole training window. LightGBM = all repo features, preprocessor and trees fit on the first 85% of the window, early stopping on its last 15%. CIs use 500 bootstrap resamples; diff = AUC(LightGBM) - AUC(lookup), paired.

| Fold | Train n (to) | Test n (window) | Lookup AUC [95% CI] | LightGBM AUC [95% CI] | Diff [95% CI] | CI vs 0 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 13,150 (2015-08-18) | 13,150 (2015-08-18 -> 2016-04-04) | 0.7677 [0.7610, 0.7752] | 0.7718 [0.7654, 0.7788] | +0.0041 [+0.0007, +0.0081] | excludes 0 |
| 2 | 26,300 (2016-04-04) | 13,151 (2016-04-04 -> 2016-11-21) | 0.7755 [0.7677, 0.7827] | 0.7764 [0.7684, 0.7835] | +0.0008 [-0.0027, +0.0047] | includes 0 |
| 3 | 39,451 (2016-11-21) | 13,150 (2016-11-21 -> 2017-07-09) | 0.7644 [0.7561, 0.7720] | 0.7646 [0.7563, 0.7715] | +0.0002 [-0.0035, +0.0037] | includes 0 |
| 4 | 52,601 (2017-07-09) | 13,151 (2017-07-09 -> 2018-01-31) | 0.7729 [0.7650, 0.7812] | 0.7725 [0.7645, 0.7805] | -0.0004 [-0.0038, +0.0028] | includes 0 |
